texte.Vos notifications sont-elles perceptible: Are your notifications perceptible and interpretable under real operating conditions, distinguished by urgency, presented on a tested modality, and is their escalation logic validated as firing early enough to allow effective action?
texte.Vos personnes désignées sont-elles avert: Are your designated persons warned about automation bias, and does the way you organise the work leave them the time to examine the outputs for real?
texte.Vos seuils d'alerte viennent-ils des dan: Do your alert thresholds come from the foreseeable hazards, the risk rating and the time the person has — and does the alert fire by itself as soon as the system reaches a state that calls for somebody?
texte.Votre SMQ est-il établi par écrit, tenu: Is your QMS established in writing, kept up to date, and its effectiveness maintained over time?
texte.Votre autorité compétente apprécie, chez: Your competent authority assesses, at your end, the impact of the measures taken by the provider on the basis of the recommendations — in particular the adequacy and consistency of the corrective measures YOU have implemented to mitigate the risks identified.
texte.Votre conception oblige-t-elle la person: Does your design oblige the designated person to really examine an output before adopting it, rather than letting it be approved out of habit?
texte.Votre interface de revue porte-t-elle, p: Does your review interface carry, for each output, its time-stamped log, its input data, its confidence scores, the associated alerts, the system version — and does it let the designated person ADD their own observations to it?

texte.« Absent » est une réponse, et compte au: “Absent” is an answer, and counts in the denominator; a document with no status has not been looked at yet.
texte.« Aucun secteur choisi » n'est pas « auc: “No sector chosen” is not “neither annex”. The first is an unanswered question; only the second pronounces an out-of-scope.
texte.« Le déployeur veillera à » n'est pas un: “The deployer shall ensure that” is not a specification: with no measurable performance criterion, the measure cannot be verified at the deployer's end.
texte.« Nous avons une interface de revue » n': “We have a review interface” is not a selection: the selection is justified scenario by scenario, against a deadline.
texte.« Partiel » n'est pas « conforme » : il: “Partial” is not “compliant”: it counts as a half.
texte.« Pas encore répondu » n'est pas « Non »: “Not answered yet” is not “No”: the score bears on the answers received, and the counter says out of how many.
texte.« Sans objet » n'y est pas une réponse :: “Not applicable” is not an answer here: it is refused and the sub-clause remains to be filled in.
texte.« Sans objet » sort le contrôle du calcu: “Not applicable” takes the control out of the calculation; “no” leaves it in, at zero. Confusing the two flatters the rate.
texte.« À planifier » est une réponse ; une ac: “To be planned” is an answer; an action with no state has not been looked at yet.
texte.« À réaliser » est une réponse, qui comp: “To be done” is an answer, counting as zero; “not applicable” takes the point out of the calculation; a point with no answer has not been looked at yet.
texte.« À évaluer » est l'état d'un système sa: “To be assessed” is the state of a system with no classification, not a classification.
